Hi 👋! I am Yash, currently working as a GPU Developer Advocate at [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/) with the [OpenHackathons Group](https://www.openhackathons.org/s/). I have now spent about two years here, helping developers, researchers, and industry teams accelerate AI and scientific workloads on GPUs through hands-on hackathons, mentorship, and technical enablement.

Prior to this, I was a Manager & Lead Data Scientist with a unicorn startup [Shiprocket](https://www.shiprocket.in/) in the realms of logistics, retail, and e-commerce.

With 7+ years of experience, I specialize in turning messy, real-world data and AI ideas into useful systems, products, and developer workflows. My work spans large-scale data processing, traditional machine learning, deep learning, GPU-accelerated AI, and Generative AI, with a current focus on multi-agent workflows and agentic AI applications. You can find more details about me [here](about.html).

Please feel free to reach out to me over [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/boi-doingthings/) or [X](https://twitter.com/boi_doingthings), or have a few words with my AI [assistant/secretary](https://hf.co/chat/assistant/66094d23a258db9f29b6c7eb) 😄. I am always up for interesting challenges and projects.
